answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable identity bond locked for the full epoch, like a reef that only grows when many small deposits anchor together. A newcomer must then pass a falcon-style spot check: a short, verifiable proof of useful work reviewed by randomly chosen peers, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds and a thousand proofs. Sybil profits spiral downward as each fake identity burns its bond on the first failed attestation, while honest agents recover theirs at settlement.
